plain: El Niño-Southern Oscillation: a natural swing in Pacific Ocean temperatures that shifts weather around the world.
The cool phase of ENSO, when parts of the Pacific are cooler than usual.
The warm phase of ENSO, when parts of the Pacific are warmer than usual.
Tiny particles in the air, thinner than a hair, small enough to get deep into your lungs.
The lowest layer of air where pollution mixes; when it is shallow, pollution is squeezed close to the ground.
A spell of weak winds when air barely moves, so pollution piles up instead of blowing away.
A path traced backwards to show where the air arriving at a city came from.
A climate zone that is hot and gets little rain, though not as little as a desert.
